title: The barge-in events of one finished call, which the core sends the Portal
description: The one definition of the Call log shape (VOI-153). The core sends it to POST /api/call-logs/ (voice/report.py) and the Portal stores it (portal/accounts/models.py CallLog) for 30 days after the call's start; tests/portal/test_call_logs.py fails when the Portal drifts from it, and tests/test_report.py when the core does. Each event is one barge-in line as the core logged it (voice/bargein.py): timings, levels, scores and short codes only, never words or audio. An event's fields are the ones .claude/rules/security.md lists for a barge-in line, nothing else.

switch.description: An audio setting as the browser applied it: on or off, or which audio echo cancelling covers. voice/serve.py SWITCH lists the same.

trace.description: A level trace around a cut, in dBFS: numbers only.

vad.description: The detector settings sent to Gemini, by name.

page_facts.description: Whether the call page sent its browser facts (VOI-159): sent, not_sent, or refused (the web Channel's check failed). Absent on a Channel with no page.

echo_cancellation.description: The microphone track's applied setting, from getSettings().

loopback.description: Whether the page's echo-cancelling WebRTC route for the agent's audio was set up, fell back to plain playback, or was skipped (iOS, where it plays silence).

sample_rate.description: The page's audio context, in Hz.

browser.description: The browser family, never the user-agent string; voice/serve.py BROWSERS lists the same.

os_version.description: The operating system's major version only.

src.description: What cut the agent off: gemini (the model's interrupted signal) or pipecat (Pipecat's own).

echo_corr.description: How closely the Caller's sound envelope followed the agent's output in the half second before the cut, 0 to 1.

echo_lag_ms.description: The delay at which echo_corr fits best.

similarity.description: The share of the Caller's first words after a barge-in that the agent had just said; a score, never the words.

no_words.description: Barge-ins with no Caller words after them.

cut_share.description: The share of the agent's stretches of speech that a barge-in cut short.

playback_gaps.description: Pauses in the agent's audio on the page that no barge-in caused, as the page counted them; absent when the page sent no facts.
